name: armis-knowledge-dev
description: DEV environment (knowledge-mcp.moose-dev.armis.com). Adds /knowledge-dev, /cwe-fix-dev, /framework-guidance-dev, and /tech-guidance-dev commands. Reads ARMIS_CLIENT_ID, ARMIS_CLIENT_SECRET, and ARMIS_TENANT_SLUG; exchanges them for a short-lived JWT on startup. Tenant isolation enforced server-side; no knowledge data stored on disk.
